name: Alfarnate (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alfarnate (a bridge and a building above a river).
history: Under the agreement of the municipal council of 2 March 2016 and the subsequent resolution of 21 March of the Directorate-General for Local Administration, the arms and flag of Alfarnate were entered in the Registro Andaluz de Entidades Locales; the flag is a cloth of proportions 2:3 whose green recalls the banner of Vélez-Málaga, the jurisdiction to which it belonged.
